scripts/v2-test-lane.sh --wait 3600 --max 9000 -- bash -c 'set -e -o pipefail
D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; D="${D%/}/maude-v2-8.3/$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"; mkdir -p "$D"
echo "== lane logs: $D"; trap '\''echo "== lane logs: $D"'\'' EXIT
STUB="$(mktemp -d)/bin"; mkdir -p "$STUB"
printf '\''#!/bin/sh\necho {\\"loggedIn\\":false}\n'\'' > "$STUB/claude"; chmod +x "$STUB/claude"
export PATH="$STUB:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" MAUDE_CLAUDE_BIN= MAUDE_E2E_ON_TOP=1 MAUDE_E2E_KEEP_FRONT=1
(cd apps/studio && MAUDE_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 bun run build.ts --release) > "$D/build-studio.log" 2>&1 || { tail -40 "$D/build-studio.log"; exit 1; }
(cd apps/desktop && MAUDE_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 npx --no-install tauri build --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json) > "$D/build-app.log" 2>&1 || { tail -40 "$D/build-app.log"; exit 1; }
cd apps/desktop/e2e
for i in 1 2 3; do for l in e2e e2e:cloud e2e:git e2e:lifecycle e2e:switchrepos e2e:tabs e2e:shell-strip e2e:remember e2e:tabs-identity e2e:cell-tab e2e:ai-quit e2e:generate-takes e2e:video-ai e2e:import-figma e2e:relaunch e2e:home e2e:first-canvas e2e:invite-landing e2e:ds-review e2e:ds-review-master e2e:ds-make e2e:ds-switch e2e:ds-outside e2e:ds-reach e2e:ds-edges e2e:ds-advanced e2e:ds-library e2e:handoff e2e:share-roles e2e:share-roles:surfaces e2e:onboarding e2e:acp-cold-start e2e:acp-fake e2e:parity e2e:sidecar-respawn e2e:team-project e2e:ai-runs e2e:team-cell e2e:team-cell-missing e2e:s20 e2e:parity:cloud; do f="$D/run$i-${l//:/-}.log"; echo "== run $i lane $l"; npm run --silent "$l" 2>&1 | tee "$f" || { echo "== RED run $i lane $l — full log $f"; exit 1; }; done; done'
